title: Filler: Ramen with Iruka-sensei
later: Ramen tonight? Maybe, once you've finished what Iruka-sensei gave you. Then we eat, believe it!

offer.speaker: naruto
offer.text: Hey, new kid! Iruka-sensei's taking me to Ichiraku tonight. Best ramen in the whole village!

offer.speaker: naruto
offer.text: You should come too! It's on the main street, south of the plaza. Iruka-sensei's paying! ...Probably.

steps.text: Meet Iruka-sensei and Naruto at Ichiraku Ramen

dialogue.speaker: naruto
dialogue.text: Hey, you came! Sit, sit! Old man, one more miso pork ramen!

dialogue.speaker: teuchi
dialogue.text: Coming right up! Any friend of Naruto's eats well at Ichiraku.

dialogue.speaker: naruto
dialogue.text: This is the best place in the whole village. I've eaten here like a thousand times. Believe it!

choices.text: A thousand? Is that all you eat?
Then I'll have what you're having.

lines.speaker: naruto
lines.text: Heh heh! You've got good taste!

dialogue.speaker: naruto
dialogue.text: Iruka-sensei, can I have seconds? And thirds?

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: One bowl, Naruto. I'm a teacher, not a bank.

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: ...He's alone most nights, you know. It's good he has someone his age to eat with. Thank you for coming.

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Here, take a bowl home with you. Rest well: lessons start early.
